cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For Mum's dinner invitations, give me the confirmed time, not an estimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the venue exactly as printed. Consistency matters when people are finding a restaurant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't remember the restaurant, do you? It's in the confirmation on your phone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then read it aloud. I'll check the spelling as you go. We verify against the source, please, not somebody's memory.

reason: Make the forgotten details visible through B challenge while A professional source-checking insistence extracts them without admitting the lapse.
